purpose: Reduce phone control hunting and close the remaining APERTURE compatibility re-entry gap without adding reader architecture.
behavior: Six existing reader jobs are one tap from the main phone surface.
Detailed use cases are secondary instead of permanently consuming reading area.
Mode selection keeps the same source/cursor and exposes scale/progress/WPM as a compact witness.
Compatibility APERTURE entry preserves focus packet into READFIELD.
No mode may silently gain source, authorship or canonical-session authority.

verification.new_probe: APERTURE alias → READFIELD exact WORD/index/WPM focus restore

stop: After CI, stop feature growth until direct phone use identifies concrete friction in the rail, mode consequences or handoff.
